about: The exception that each client library raises for the error pages in content/develop/reference/errors/common/, and what its message looks like. Keyed by page file name. Each client was run against a live server, with the same scenarios as build/errors/live_checks.py: redis-py as recorded in build/errors/live_baseline.json, and the others with build/errors/live_clients.py on redis:8.10 (server 8.10.2), in build/errors/client_baselines/. The notes on MOVED and ASK about cluster clients that follow the redirect come from source.

lettuce.name: Lettuce
lettuce.note: The async API wraps the exception in an `ExecutionException` (`get()`) or a `CompletionException` (`join()`).

redis-py.message: <slot> <endpoint>:<port>
redis-py.note: `RedisCluster` follows the redirect itself and raises this error only if it can't.

jedis.message: ASK <slot> <endpoint>:<port>
jedis.note: `JedisCluster` follows the redirect itself and raises this error only if it can't.

node-redis.message: ASK <slot> <endpoint>:<port>
node-redis.note: `createCluster` follows the redirect itself, and throws `MaxCommandRedirectionsError` after 16 attempts by default.

lettuce.message: ASK <slot> <endpoint>:<port>
lettuce.note: `RedisClusterClient` follows the redirect itself, and raises this error after 5 redirects by default.

go-redis.message: ASK <slot> <endpoint>:<port>
go-redis.note: `ClusterClient` follows the redirect itself, and returns this error after `MaxRedirects` attempts (3 by default).

lettuce.message: Unable to connect to <host>/<unresolved>:<port>
lettuce.note: The cause is a `RedisCommandExecutionException` with the server's `WRONGPASS` message. `AUTH` with a password for a user that has none raises `RedisCommandExecutionException` with the `ERR AUTH <password> called without any password configured…` message, and no `RedisConnectionException`.

go-redis.message: WRONGPASS invalid username-password pair or user is disabled.
go-redis.note: `AUTH` with a password for a user that has none returns `ERR AUTH <password> called without any password configured…`, which has no check of its own.
